svg.title: Every case, every run: pass or fail
svg.desc: Grid of 40 evaluation cases by 6 runs. The offline baseline passes 23 of 40. GPT-6 Luna with prompt v1 passes 37, prompt v2 passes 39 in the main run and 38, 40 and 38 in its three repeats. CF-02 fails in most live runs; INJ-03 fails in two repeats and in v1 only under the original injection rule.
svg.text: Every case, every run: pass or fail
40 cases in columns, grouped by category; 6 runs in rows. Original scoring.
